about_the_game:
⚡ Swifty – Precision. Speed. Survival.

Race through challenging levels where speed is everything. Swifty tests your reflexes, timing, and precision in a fast-paced 2D platformer designed for players who love a challenge. Dodge deadly traps, pull off flawless jumps, and perfect your runs. Show that annoying frog who is the real "Swifty" here.
💥 Key Features:

  • Fast-paced gameplay that rewards precision and speed

  • Tight, responsive controls for smooth movement

  • Challenging levels with deadly obstacles

  • Minimalist art style focused on gameplay clarity
